revoked.note: https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/chat.postMessage lists invalid_auth; Slack's own SDK test server answers HTTP 200 with exactly this body (slackapi/python-slack-sdk tests/slack_sdk/web/mock_web_api_handler.py)

forbidden.note: https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/chat.postMessage lists missing_scope; method errors arrive as HTTP 200 with ok:false (slackapi/java-slack-sdk docs/english/guides/web-api-basics.md)

rateLimit.note: https://docs.slack.dev/apis/web-api/rate-limits documents 429 with Retry-After; the body is the one Slack's own SDK test server sends (slackapi/python-slack-sdk tests/slack_sdk/web/mock_web_api_handler.py)
